Areas

Dozens of regions across five genres (Old West, fantasy, sci-fi, modern and prehistoric), from the safe frontier town to the Abyss. Each shows its level range, terrain, monsters, resources and how to get there.

Old WestFantasySci-fiModern Each area is styled for its genre.

Ashfall Junction

Safe hub · Old West 27 rooms one floor

An Old West boom town where the roads between worlds meet: the Silver Spur Saloon, shops, temple, Chrome Clinic, guild and the Hall of Rebirth. Almost every room here is safe from combat.

Getting thereYou start here.
Terrainconcrete (11), metal (6), stone (6), dirt (3), grass (1)
Resourcesore ×4
Monsters🐀 giant rat (1)
Quest giversFixer Torv, Doc Elara, Brann the Smith, Mara the Innkeeper, Captain Hale, Old Pell, Inker Dax, Armorer Gunnar Ironbound, Salvage Boss Pike, Engineer Dex, Widow Mae, Dusty Pete

Levels 186 to 191 · Sci-fi 51 rooms two floors

Modern District

Levels 10 to 16 · Modern 96 rooms two floors

Step up through the arch in Ashfall Square into a modern strip: the Multi-Mart superstore with departments, Westfield Shopping Center, Sunset Acres Trailer Park, burgers, hot dogs, soda and two gas stations with restrooms, plus Meridian Tower, an eleven-level office building (a basement and ten floors, reached by elevator) whose top-floor CEO is guarded by three bodyguards. Modern gear, shoppers, stockers, trailer park brawlers and corporate zombies.

Getting theremodern from the starting square

The Primeval Rift

Levels 21 to 28 · Prehistoric 22 rooms one floor

Step into the mysterious portal at the Mirage Gate in the Sunscorch Dunes (enter portal) and you arrive in a prehistoric valley of tree ferns, tar pits and dinosaurs: raptors, pterosaurs, triceratops, stegosaurs, allosaurs, a spinosaur and Rex the Tyrant. Dr. Mara Quill runs the camp at the landing.

Getting thereprehistoric from the starting square
Terrainconcrete (21), dirt (1)
Resourcesore ×4, herb ×5

Quest giversDr. Mara Quill, Uga the Barterer

Sol and Mercury

Levels 150 to 200 · Sci-fi 151 rooms one floor

The sun and the first planet: 150 rooms in a 15 x 10 grid at the far end of the future realm. On Mercury, iron-based lifeforms (ferrous crawlers, magnetite swarms, iron golems, sentinels, cast-iron colossi) have forge-cities and fight a war against the creatures of Sol, the sun (sprites, plasma elementals, flare drakes, priests of the Sun, corona serpents, photon knights). Ferrum Prime, Iron Tyrant of Mercury (level 190), Helia, Oracle of Sol (195) and Sol Invictus, the Living Star (200) are the bosses. The monsters are far above the level cap of 100: only high-remort heroes (and anyone with remorted equipment) survive. Dr. Helena Voss and Aten the Envoy give 11 quests.

Mount Olympus

Levels 86 to 100 · Fantasy 61 rooms one floor

The home of the Greek gods (not Athena, but the Titan Cronus is chained in Tartarus): 60 rooms in a 10 x 6 grid from sunlit foothills to the Throne of Olympus. Twelve gods in their halls (Hera, Ares, Apollo, Artemis, Aphrodite, Hephaestus, Hermes, Demeter, Dionysus, Hestia, Cronus), with Zeus as the primary boss. The heroes of Greek myth (Odysseus, Achilles, Heracles, Perseus, Orpheus and Atalanta) give the quests.

The Otherworld

Avalon and Camelot

Where stone gave way to metal: 50 rooms from Bronze Age hill-forts and tin roads to Iron Age war-camps and slag-fields. Two warlords fight over the last tin and the best iron: Brask, the Bronze King, and Dagan Ironhand, the Iron Lord. Hild the Smith-Mother gives 5 quests.

The Void

Level 250+ · Future 100 rooms one floor

The darkest place in the Future realm: 100 rooms written in dark gray, open only to those whose level plus remorts reach 250 (level 200 and Remort 50). Every monster is a hard "void" (crawlers, stalkers, maws, knights, seers and hulks) and Nihil, the Void Sovereign, waits at the end. Crossing the threshold starts an automatic 30-minute contract to kill every void, with a huge reward.

The Extinction Event

Level 200 · Prehistoric 60 rooms one floor

The toughest area in the game, at the far end of the prehistoric realm (the realm with the fewest areas): 60 rooms in the burning crater of the meteor that ended the dinosaurs, where apex predators of every age turned into something worse. Every monster is level 200 and built tough. Bosses: the Meteor Titan, Apex Tyrannus (the first rex) and Chronophage, Devourer of Ages. Chrona the Timekeeper gives 8 quests.

The Mammoth Caverns

Levels 26 to 33 · Prehistoric 26 rooms two floors

A three-level cave system under the Primeval Rift, entered with in from Stegosaur Valley: the painted upper caves of the Mammoth Clan, dripping tunnels with crystals, creepers and a mammoth graveyard, and the deep throne cavern of Grog the Great, a very large caveman with a very large club. Elder Ugga keeps the fire at the cave mouth.

Nightfall Hollow

Levels 33 to 39 · Fantasy 26 rooms one floor

Past the Shattered Citadel's crypt gate (type in) lies a cursed village under a sky with no stars: vampires in their manor, werewolves in the woods, witches at the crossroads and demons at the Brimstone Gate. Father Aldric runs the hunters' chapel.
